ctx.x: heard the guys say, the little that I've read, he's a legend.

Uh-huh. Again, did you have any thoughts or feelings, because towards the end of the '40's then we had the beginning of the era of the cool music, with Miles Davis and Stan Getz. In fact, you were telling me some things about Stan Getz. He played -- he worked with you, right?

Yes, Stan Getz was a great musician. He is a great musician, I should say. I met Stan Getz out on the west coast, the far west. In fact, he made a tour up in the state of Washington, and this was just before he joined Benny Goodman. You know he played a stint with Benny Goodman. And there was always something about him that I liked. He was an excellent reader. And I had four horns. We played in San Francisco. We played in Portland, Oregon, and Seattle, Washington.
